title: Revision assembles an understood whole

captions.physics: Rebuilding a familiar rule’s inadequate explanation

meaning: Rebuilding an inadequate explanation can clarify a shared principle and bring wholeness to understanding in which differences have their own place.
text: Wholeness can emerge after a familiar rule is revised. The Tower in the physical position of Ajna suggests jointly rebuilding its inadequate explanation. The Hierophant in energy supports clarifying a shared principle’s foundation. The World in emotions feels renewed understanding’s wholeness. Relationships between previously exceptional examples can become pleasingly visible. Your view gains understandable substance while preserving material that failed to fit within an earlier account of the question.

For example, you associated a clear story with strict chronological sequence. Examining an understandable story that returns to the past, you stop treating that order as sufficient foundations. **Revision can gather a principle and different examples into an understood whole.** Interest in clarity’s basis reveals causes, expectations and consequences. Chronology gains its place among other methods. Wholeness concerns understandable relationships between parts. You can explain why two different forms helped clarify a story without declaring one wrong or losing each person’s particular reading experience within the comparison.

The risk is making a sense of coherence proof that the new structure explains every story. Seeking foundations preserves a subject. These examples revealed different connections within clear narrative. Your view remains whole through actual relationships while another work may require its own consideration, beyond turning a principle into a ready answer before becoming acquainted with material.
